name: seek-thermal-firmware-toolkit
description: Dump, decrypt and reflash Seek Thermal camera firmware — browser app, CLI and shared core.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @seek-fw/core && npm run build --workspace @seek-fw/cli && npm run build --workspace @seek-fw/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build --force && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web/tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web/tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
